[curious, lively, starts speaking immediately] You do not need a million followers. You might need only one thousand, if they are the right thousand. In two thousand eight, Wired co-founder Kevin Kelly wrote an essay about what he called one thousand true fans. A true fan buys almost everything you make. They preorder, they show up, and they drag their friends along. If each one spends a hundred dollars a year, that is a hundred thousand dollars. No viral video needed at all. Newsletters, memberships, and small products all run on this idea. Depth beats reach. You do not need a million followers.
